anchor.snippet: test('animated PTY output and a stream burst keep both native terminals interactive', { timeout: 45000 }, async () => {

entries.note: The animated fixture and shell are real PTYs; native text/key events must produce executed responses in both. The stale sequence-1 burst fills the native transport without fabricating actual process output or changing its retained snapshot. A local TCP proxy forces an outage without restarting the sidecar. Wait for the fresh attached flag as well as connection and retained text before testing new input; otherwise an old screen can falsely signal readiness. Input typed offline must never appear after reconnection, and session count/PIDs must stay unchanged. An optional local ended-CLI ANSI recording replays bytes through the same fixture without starting another provider conversation; recordings remain private ignored evidence. The test owns and cleans up its GUI, proxy, service and both PTYs.
